fields.description_1: SoDrive is a driving school website built around helping learners understand lesson options, packages, the route to a licence and the next step toward starting lessons. The portfolio copy needed to describe that learner journey clearly rather than referring to job opportunities.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around practical driving-school information, package comparison, trust signals and clear trial-lesson or contact actions. The responsive layout keeps the same decision path easy to follow for learners on mobile and desktop.

fields.description_1: Boekhoudsnel presents bookkeeping support for entrepreneurs who want administrative work explained in practical terms. The website needed to make the service, expected support and route to contact understandable without relying on broad finance language.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress content around the bookkeeping proposition, practical questions and a clear enquiry route. The linked URL stored in ACF was malformed and could not be independently verified, so I removed that invalid value instead of replacing it with an unverified domain.

fields.description_1: Voltworks presents energy solutions through a service-focused website where visitors need to understand the available technical options before requesting advice or a quotation. The content therefore needed to make the offer concrete instead of using generic language about enquiries.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the main energy services, supporting project information and clear contact or quotation actions. Technical detail remains available, but the first layer helps visitors identify the relevant solution and move toward a conversation.

fields.description_1: Jouwgroenteboer is an ecommerce experience for ordering fresh fruit and vegetables online. The website needed to make categories, products, delivery information and the shopping route easy to understand so customers can move from browsing to ordering without unnecessary friction.
fields.description_2: I organised the WooCommerce journey around product discovery, clear category structure and direct cart actions. Supporting information stays close to the shopping flow, while the responsive layout keeps browsing and checkout practical on smaller screens.

fields.description_1: Kervana brings installation services such as climate, heating and related technical solutions together in one WordPress presentation. The website needed to distinguish those services clearly and give visitors enough practical context before they request advice or a quotation.
fields.description_2: I structured the content around the main installation routes, project or service proof and direct enquiry actions. Shorter sections make the technical offer easier to scan, while the responsive layout keeps contact and quotation options close to the relevant service.

fields.description_1: Envolt presents electrical and energy services through a focused business website. The portfolio copy needed to explain the actual technical offer and decision path instead of using a sentence accidentally stored in the URL field and generic wording about enquiries.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around the main electrical and energy services, supporting information and clear contact actions. The malformed ACF link was replaced with the project domain, and the content now describes the service journey rather than a generic page-improvement process.

fields.description_1: Ozturk Motion Pictures is a wedding-focused visual portfolio built around films, photography, couple stories and galleries. The website needed to let prospective couples understand the style of the work quickly and move naturally from viewing previous weddings to making contact.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress presentation around visual project browsing, concise service context and a clear enquiry route. Large imagery and galleries remain the main proof, while supporting copy helps couples understand what they can request without distracting from the portfolio.

fields.description_1: Odetra presents international real-estate investment and project-development opportunities. The website needed to keep property and market information clear enough for visitors to understand the proposition before moving into company information or direct contact.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around projects, market context and the company proposition, with a clear route from evaluating opportunities to making an enquiry. The content hierarchy keeps property information central and avoids generic claims that could apply to any real-estate website.

fields.description_1: Marco Verhuurt is a rental-focused website where visitors need to understand the available offer, practical conditions and availability before making an enquiry. The portfolio copy therefore needed to describe the rental journey directly instead of speaking generally about page clarity.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the rental options, availability and the next contact step. Practical information appears before the enquiry point, giving visitors enough context to decide whether an available option fits their needs.
